hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of BAT's transformation strategy: transitioning from a traditional cigarette company to a smoke-free business by 2035. It is the key signal of its structural shift.

kpis.name: Smokeless Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue derived from smoke-free products (vaping, heated tobacco, nicotine pouches).
kpis.description: Smoke-free products represented 17.9% of group revenue in the first half of 2024. Target: reach 50% by 2035.
kpis.signal: Strategic transition toward a sustainable growth model.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: The group generated £27.28 billion in revenue in 2023.
kpis.signal: Stable revenue despite regulatory pressure and declining combustible tobacco.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating margin of £12.46 billion on £27.28 billion of revenue in 2023, approximately 45.7%.
kpis.signal: High margin maintained despite transformation, supported by pricing and cost reduction.

kpis.name: Smokeless Product Consumers
kpis.explanation: Number of individuals using BAT's smoke-free products.
kpis.description: BAT had 26.4 million consumers of its smoke-free brands in 2024.
kpis.signal: 26.4 million users in 2024, on track to reach 50 million by 2030.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.

kpis.name: Annual Revenue from New Categories
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated by smoke-free products (Vuse, glo, Velo) in the current year.
kpis.description: New category products (Vuse, glo, Velo) have generated over £3 billion in annual revenue since their introduction ten years ago.
kpis.signal: Over £3 billion in annual revenue generated by new categories.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. BAT does not position AI as a strategic lever in its transformation toward a smokeless world.
evidence: No reference to AI, algorithms, or machine learning technologies in the text.
Cited innovations are product-focused (Vuse, glo, Velo), not digital technologies.
Strategy is based on science, regulation, and marketing, not digital transformation or AI.
